verified_scope: 48 tasks sourced from real research repositories

sources.claim_boundary: A direct MLE benchmark and integrity precedent; it does not make a naturally logged true-sibling predictor benchmark its primary released or evaluated unit.

sources.title: BAITBENCH: Measuring Agent Reward Hacking with Optional Shortcuts Planted in ML Tasks

canonical run evidence and a two-judge reward-hacking protocol
sources.claim_boundary: A direct ML-agent evaluation-integrity precedent; it studies behavioral reward hacking rather than cross-family prediction over logged search-tree sibling decisions.
